subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: Should a QQ Bot direct C2C sender be allowed to resolve fallback plugin and exec approvals without an explicit non-wildcard allowFrom entry or configured execApprovals approver?
rationale: Current shipped policy deliberately separates permission to chat in an open DM from authority to approve high-impact actions, while the paired PR proposes collapsing that distinction for C2C callbacks.

options.title: Preserve explicit authorization
options.body: Keep the existing security boundary and fix the UX so unauthorized users receive immediate configuration guidance instead of a misleading button followed by a timeout.

options.title: Trust bound C2C identity
options.body: Permit implicit C2C approval only after defining and live-proving a bot, account, and request identity binding that excludes arbitrary open-DM senders.

options.title: Accept blanket C2C bypass
options.body: Merge the paired PR's direct-chat bypass and explicitly document that open DM access grants approval authority.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit authorization
recommendation.body: Keep the existing security boundary and fix the UX so unauthorized users receive immediate configuration guidance instead of a misleading button followed by a timeout.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the authorization-hardening change and is the strongest current-history owner for the affected approval boundary.
